title: ophioglossum crotalophoroides subsp. typicum
intro: Ophioglossum crotalophoroides subsp. typicum, commonly known as the adder's tongue fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant is known for its unique appearance, with long, flat fronds that resemble the tongue of an adder, hence its common name. The health benefits of Ophioglossum crotalophoroides subsp. typicum include its ability to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
